title: ‘Imperfect Women’ Showrunner on Debate Writers Had About Episode 2 Bombshell: “They’re Making Bad Choices Sometimes — We All Do”
summary: Annie Weisman also discusses the biggest challenges and changes of adapting Araminta Hall's novel for TV with the trio of stars Kerry Washington, Kate Mara and Elisabeth Moss, and why it's a limited series: "We wanted to land in a place where you feel like you know what happens."
